concept_options.title: The Physics Chalkboard: Newton's 3 Laws Solved Step-by-Step
concept_options.hook: Why does everything you think about motion feel completely backwards?
concept_options.visual_approach: Chalkboard whiteboard walkthrough with animated free-body force vectors and progressive equation reveals.
concept_options.target_audience: Students and curious learners seeking visual intuition for physics
key_points: Law 1: Motion is the default state; stopping requires an outside force (friction).
Law 2: F = ma means mass resists acceleration, visually shown via vector scaling.
Law 3: Action and reaction forces act on separate objects and never cancel out.
concept_options.core_message: Forces do not cause motion; unbalanced forces cause changes in motion.
concept_options.cta: Next time you brake in a car, remember you're feeling inertia!
concept_options.why_this_works: Directly tackles the intuitive impetus misconceptions proven by physics education research using visual proof.

concept_options.title: The Truck and the Bug: The Third Law Paradox
concept_options.hook: When a speeding semi-truck hits a tiny mosquito, which one hits harder?
concept_options.visual_approach: Collision diagram breaking down force pairs and dramatic acceleration disparity.
key_points: The force on the truck equals the force on the bug.
Different masses create drastically different accelerations (a = F/m).
concept_options.why_this_works: Confronts the #1 most failed question in physics education research.

concept_options.title: Newton's 3 Laws in 60 Seconds: Visual Exam Prep
concept_options.hook: Master Newton's three laws before your next exam in sixty seconds flat.
concept_options.visual_approach: Split-screen exam question cards with rapid visual solution breakdown.
key_points: Rule 1: Net force zero = constant velocity.
Rule 2: Calculate acceleration with a = F/m.
Rule 3: Identify the interacting body pair.
concept_options.why_this_works: High-yield revision format with immediate test utility.
